title: Claude Enterprise plan | Claude by Anthropic

facts.fact: Anthropic's testimonial from a large software company reports that 12 hours of prototyping work collapsed into about 20 minutes, a 97% reduction in prototyping time, using Claude Managed Agents.
facts.quote: We saw 12 hours of prototyping work collapse into about 20 minutes. Then your whole team can jump in and refine it together.
